scenario: LUNI.8.4 — multiplication of two dimensioned values produces a result whose unit the compiler cannot infer; the spec rejects implicit unit algebra. `r.w * r.h` where both are meter-typed slots rejects with DS_VALIDATE_DIM_AMBIGUOUS. Pin: even SAME-dim multiplication errors (the result would be meter_squared but that's the author's annotation to declare).
rules_ds:
schema Rect scope logical:
    w: meter key
    h: meter mutable

rule big:
    Rect r where (r.w * r.h) > 10
->
    log info "big rect"
